hero.description: Merit Real Solutions connects buyers, sellers and mediators through verified, Admin-checked property services across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

story.title: Our Story
story.body: Merit Real Solutions is a property-focused marketplace that helps Buyers find suitable properties, helps Sellers publish and manage their own listings, and helps Mediators manage leads and site visits on behalf of their clients. Every property and every user account is verified by our Admin team before it goes live, so communication stays transparent and property discovery stays trustworthy from the first enquiry through to the final visit.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To simplify property discovery and connect verified buyers, sellers and mediators through a transparent platform.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To become a trusted real-estate marketplace for Telugu and English users.

faq.contactSellerQ: How can I contact a property seller?
faq.contactSellerA: Open any property listing and use the Call or WhatsApp button, or express interest and our team will connect you.
faq.postPropertyQ: How can I post my property?
faq.postPropertyA: Register as a Seller, wait for Admin approval, then use "Post Property" to publish your listing.
faq.registrationA: Browsing properties doesn't require an account, but posting a property, saving favourites or scheduling visits does.
faq.adminApprovalA: Every new account and every property listing is reviewed by our Admin team before it becomes fully active.
faq.scheduleVisitQ: Can I schedule a property visit?
faq.scheduleVisitA: Yes, use "Schedule Visit" on any property page or ask our team to arrange one for you.
faq.teluguSupportA: Yes, use the language toggle in the navigation bar to switch between English and Telugu.
faq.whatsappContactA: Yes, use the WhatsApp button on this page or on any property listing to message us directly.
